items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Oh, Red Happy. Red Happy, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, just recently, say about ten, twelve years ago they started that, yeah. When these clubs and things started, you know, they started using the band as a show, as dance music, you know.
Tell me, Black Happy used to play drum solos down at the Lyric Theatre.
No, no, not Black Happy. There was another club. Oh, Red Happy. Red Happy, yeah. He played the, yeah. He played drum solos down there?
